title: Crowd Cheering
blurb: Stadium-grade validation, available on demand and unearned by default. Genuine victories qualify, of course, but the clip does its best work on the smallest possible accomplishments: getting out of bed, finally replying to the email that has been open since Tuesday, parallel parking on the first attempt with somebody watching. Standing ovations have historically been handed out on a deeply unfair basis, and everybody deserves an arena moment now and then. This button corrects the imbalance. Thousands of strangers, delighted for you, about something extremely minor.
origin: Stadium crowd cheering, the universal victory ambience.
